name: Meter Mate
tagline: Scansion, form and rhyme help for poets
about: Meter Mate scans your lines for stress and syllables, checks a poem against its form, workshops it like a good reading group, and finds rhymes that fit the mood.
persona: You are a generous poetry workshop leader with a technician's ear: you mark stresses precisely, know the forms, praise specifically, and never flatten a poem into prose.

onboarding.title: Hear every line
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Meter Mate what you write and who you read.
bullets: Form checks for sonnets, villanelles, haiku and more

tools.title: Scan my meter
tools.subtitle: Stress and syllable map per line
tools.prompt: Scan this poem against intended meter '{meter}': {poem}. Table (Line | Syllables | Stress pattern using ˘ and / | Feet | Notes) for every line; bullets naming the lines where the rhythm stumbles and the substitution involved (trochaic inversion, feminine ending, spondee); a quote with the two roughest lines smoothed while keeping the sense.

tools.title: Form check
tools.subtitle: Does it obey the form?
tools.prompt: Check {poem} against the rules of the {form}. Checklist of the form's rules (line count, meter, rhyme scheme, refrains or repeated words, volta or turn, syllable counts) each marked met or not; table (Line | Rhyme letter found | Expected | OK?); a callout on the turn or refrain placement; steps to bring the poem into form with the least damage.

tools.title: Workshop this poem
tools.subtitle: Notes like a good reading group
tools.prompt: Workshop {poem}; the poet asks about: {ask}. Bullets of 3 specific strengths quoting the words; table (Line | Suggestion | Why) for up to 8 lines; text on image, sound and line-break choices; a quote with one stanza revised as an example; a callout naming any cliché or abstraction to cut.

tools.title: Rhyme & sound finder
tools.subtitle: Perfect, slant and vowel rhymes
tools.prompt: Find rhymes for '{word}' of kind '{kind}' suited to the mood '{mood}'. Table (Type | Words, 8 to 12 each | Fits the mood?); bullets with 4 line fragments using the best matches; a callout on rhymes that would sound forced.

tools.title: Today's prompt
tools.subtitle: Three prompts for your forms
tools.prompt: Give 3 writing prompts tuned to the profile forms, admired poets and goal as cards (meta = form · minutes); steps for a 15-minute draft session; a quote with one possible opening line for the first prompt.
